business_problem: IRCEM needed to answer growing volumes of customer questions about complex pension, insurance, and social-protection topics without forcing advisors to handle every inquiry manually by email or phone.
solution_summary: IRCEM partnered with IBM Cloud Expert Labs to build a chatbot and then an assisted-messaging capability around IBM watsonx Assistant. The initial chatbot project focused on social-action questions and used existing documentation, FAQs, and prior emails to automate answers and direct users to the right online resources. IBM trained IRCEM teams to configure, test, and tune watsonx Assistant so the organization could gradually internalize both the technology and the AI operating skills. After the first topic was stabilized, IRCEM expanded the bot into areas such as retirement and provident insurance, then added an assisted-messaging flow in which AI analyzes the text of an outbound customer email and surfaces general or personal information from IRCEM data before the message is sent. This architecture blends self-service automation with advisor augmentation, reducing unnecessary messages while preserving a human handoff when the AI cannot fully resolve the request.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx Assistant
solution_components.role: Powers the chatbot and assisted-messaging workflows that answer or augment customer inquiries.

solution_components.name: IBM Cloud Expert Labs

data_flow: Documentation, prior emails, and IRCEM data feed watsonx Assistant, which answers customer questions in the chatbot or analyzes draft customer emails in real time and returns relevant general or personal information before the advisor workflow falls back to traditional processing.
business_outcome: IRCEM reduced the load on customer-relations teams, improved the consistency of answers, and created an AI-assisted service model that blends self-service automation with advisor augmentation.
